title: Sonilo AI Video-to-Music Generation for Content Creators
summary: Sonilo is a generative AI platform that creates synchronized soundtracks by analyzing video motion, pacing, and transitions. It provides professional-grade music that automatically aligns with visual content without requiring complex text prompts.
research_notes: Offers API access for enterprise developers and generates multiple stylistic variations for each video upload.

evolution.summary: The service has matured into a commercial platform featuring a dedicated ComfyUI node integration and a strategic partnership with Shutterstock.
